dialogues.speaker: Rena
dialogues.text: Machines make work easier, but there's something rather boring about them.

dialogues.speaker: Rena
dialogues.text: Sure, but where should we start...?

dialogues.speaker: Rena
dialogues.text: I was just thinking that I should meet up with a friend at the opera house on my off day — we can watch an opera or a trial, either is fine with me.

dialogues.speaker: Rena
dialogues.text: I've been on duty at the harbor lately, and I've been inspecting machines on the regular, day in and day out — nothing special.

dialogues.speaker: Rena
dialogues.text: But thinking about it a different way, boring work might be meaningless, but at least it's safe.

dialogues.speaker: Rena
dialogues.text: If I were still dispatched to the Fontaine Research Institute for further studies in mechanical knowledge, I might no longer have legs to touch land, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What if I want to take a boat to the Court of Fontaine...

dialogues.speaker: Rena
dialogues.text: Ah, you speak of the aquabuses that travel along Fontaine's waterways, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Rena
dialogues.text: This is the starting point of the Clementine Line, which heads from Romaritime Harbor to the Court of Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Rena
dialogues.text: If you want to take one of those boats to the Court, just take a seat on that long bench, and one will arrive shortly.

dialogues.speaker: Rena
dialogues.text: The Melusine tour guide on board will introduce you to... some assorted trivia, so stay tuned.

dialogues.speaker: Rena
dialogues.text: That was an interesting game! You're really good at this!

dialogues.speaker: Rena
dialogues.text: Aww! I should have used a better strategy...
